name: VaultNorth
positioning: VaultNorth brings the calm, long-horizon thinking of private banking to anyone who wants to understand their money, through patient education rather than products or predictions.
audience: Thoughtful professionals and multi-generational families, roughly 30 to 65, who are building or stewarding wealth and want plain-spoken financial literacy without hype.
strategy: Borrow the codes of heritage private banking (engraving, gold hairlines, roman numerals, symmetry) and use them to make financial education feel premium, trustworthy and unhurried. Every piece of content teaches a principle, never sells a product, and carries a clear educational-not-advice disclaimer. Social output is organised as numbered series (field guides, notes, letters) to build a collectible, library-like presence.

contrastPairs.use: body text and headlines on dark
body text on light ledger panels
text on accent panels and cards
muted body copy (mist tint) on dark
muted body copy on accent panels
gold eyebrows, numerals and links on dark
disclaimers and meta text on dark

fonts.mono: none (tabular lining numerals in Cormorant for figures)

designSystem.spacing: Generous 8px-based scale; sections breathe at 88-168px vertical padding; content held in a centered 1180px column with symmetrical gutters.
designSystem.radius: 0px everywhere: square, engraved edges; the only curves are circular rosettes and compass rings.
designSystem.borders: Fine 1px Engraver's Gold hairlines, often doubled (1px + offset 0.6px) like a banknote frame, with small rotated-diamond terminals.
designSystem.imagery: No photography. Original line-engraved SVG: guilloche rosettes, compass roses, porticos and diagonal engraving hatch textures.
designSystem.shapes: Circles, diamonds, triangular pediments and fluted columns; strict bilateral symmetry.
designSystem.buttons: Uppercase Lato 700 with wide 0.22em tracking; primary is solid gold with teal label, secondary is a gold outline with an offset second hairline.
designSystem.cards: Transparent or deep-teal panels framed by a gold hairline plus an inset second frame that expands on hover; centered content led by an italic roman numeral.
designSystem.motifs: North-star compass monogram, guilloche rosettes, fine gold hairlines, engraved hatch textures, roman-numeral sequencing (I-VII) for sections and series.

artDirection: Compose every creative like a page from a private bank's annual letter: symmetrical, framed by a double gold hairline, with one engraved centrepiece (rosette, compass or portico) and abundant negative space. Headlines are set in Cormorant with one italic gold phrase for emphasis; supporting copy is light Lato in a muted mist tint. Number everything in roman numerals to build a collectible series, and keep a visible educational-not-advice line on any piece that discusses money. Never show photography, price charts with real tickers, or promised returns; figures are always labelled hypothetical.
